deployments_detail.use: EVA AI chatbot (instant answers on cards/accounts/loans, sub-0.4s response)
In-house "Neev" generative AI platform + real-time fraud monitoring system built by internal engineering team

EVA (Electronic Virtual Assistant), an AI-powered conversational chatbot on the HDFC Bank website (and via Hindi/voice search) answering customer queries on credit cards, savings accounts, personal loans etc. Billed as India's first AI banking chatbot; reported handling millions of queries. [Senseforth]
deployments_detail.value: Handled 2.7 million queries / 1.2 million conversations in first six months (per Indian Express)

deployments_detail.use: OnChat, an AI chatbot on Facebook Messenger enabling conversational payments and transactions (bill payments, mobile recharges, cab/travel bookings). [Niki.ai]

HDFC Bank One (Customer Experience Hub), an AI/ML-driven conversational bot on both voice and chat, with AI-based customer query intent identification, deployed to centralize and streamline contact-center operations across channels. [In-house]

Migration to the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify data and accelerate ETL/analytics powering credit risk analytics (CRAIN department), model building/deployment, fraud control data integration, and marketing campaign optimization. [Databricks]

Neev, an in-house full-stack enterprise Generative AI platform providing model access, governance, orchestration and deployment across customer service, lending, wealth management and internal operations; scaling 15+ high-impact GenAI programs (earlier framed as 'Project Indra'). [In-house]
AI/ML-based Business Rule Engine enabling intelligent, real-time credit decisioning and instant loan approvals across customer segments including new-to-bank (NTB) customers. [In-house]

Partnership with Microsoft to modernize data landscape on Azure (Federated Data Lake) to enable advanced analytics using AI/ML and deep-learning capabilities as part of its Future Ready digital transformation. [Microsoft Azure]
GenAI Academy to train employees on generative AI, including where human judgment must override AI outputs, as part of enterprise-wide AI skilling. [In-house]
deployments_detail.value: 50,600+ employees underwent AI training in FY26

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI used to extract key fields from customer documents and render the data into the trade finance system, automating trade finance document processing. [In-house]

Real-time fraud detection / financial crime monitoring engine on the Neev platform that flags suspicious transactions in real time (sub-second/milliseconds) and surfaces hidden money-laundering patterns. [In-house]
